test_title: PYST 14: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends, A, B, C, D and E, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. D is sitting to the immediate left of A. C is sitting to the immediate right of B. B is not sitting adjacent to A. Who is sitting second to the right of D?
solution:
The logic that follows here is 

1) D is sitting to the immediate left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85e5923f6d9fbd56b0669a1b7444a50c31810cde26ac491d1fa9d8404586422c.png] 

2) C is sitting to the immediate right of B.

3) B is not sitting adjacent to A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41b43c837fce8b87490bd632d78605dc4ac8571dc8aec68e924d6ddf29600c76.png] 

The final seating arrangement will be

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4283b135f554303fb1b5a7bdd487a570ca583e45c10c87d07bb28b4e5e08a6a.png] 

Second to the right of D is **'E'**.

Hence, the correct answer is E.
